description: Built-in exercises missing from free-exercise-db, added for the owner's Min-Max Phase 2 routines and Liftoff history. Same shape as assets/exercises.json; ids start with sp_. Instructions are written for this app.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Set the shoulder pads so you can stand fully upright with feet mid-platform.
Release the safety and sit down under control until your knees are deeply bent.
Drive through the whole foot to stand back up without locking the knees hard.
Keep your back against the pad for every rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Y Raise
instructions: Set a bench to about 30° and sit with your back against it.
With arms hanging and a slight elbow bend, lift the dumbbells up and out into a Y shape.
Stop around head height, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand facing the machine with the pads against your forearms just above the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Resist the weight on the way down without pausing at the bottom.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
instructions: Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the bar a little wider than shoulder width.
Pull your chest towards the bar, driving the elbows down.
Lower under control to a full stretch. More counterweight means more assistance.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold a straight bar on a low pulley with an overhand grip, forearms resting on your thighs or a bench.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar, then lower it through a full stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable set around hip height or higher and take the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is level with your shoulder.
Lower slowly, keeping tension on the side delt the whole time.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a medium stride forward.
Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor, then step through into the next rep.
Count reps per leg.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip (Machine)
instructions: Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the dip handles with straight arms.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, leaning slightly forward.
Press back up to straight arms. More counterweight means more assistance.

exercises.name: Machine Single-Arm Reverse Fly
instructions: Set the seat so the handle sits at chest height and face the pad of a reverse pec deck.
Take one handle with the working arm, a slight bend in the elbow, and keep your chest on the pad.
Sweep the handle out and back in the largest semi-circle you can, leading with the elbow, until your arm is in line with your shoulders.
Pause, then return under control. Finish all reps on one side before switching.
